children: Wintergreen Acquisition entered into an unsecured, non-interest-bearing convertible promissory note with its sponsor to fund a one-month extension of its SPAC deadline. The $184,635 note matures upon the earlier of a business combination closing or liquidation and will be forgiven if no merger is completed. The sponsor waived any claim to the trust account related to the note and may convert the balance into units at $10.00 per unit upon deal completion. The company continues to pursue its merger with KIKA Technology.
